regions.merged_text: I hope this finds you all well and that things have been going at least not too bad. I want to thank you for Wartime Correspondence between Pres. Roos'vlt and Pope Pius XII ... It is quite a masterpiece of compilation of masterpieces of master-minds on basic principles and parallel lines in Church and State in time of crisis pulling in perfect harmony together. It could be well placed in the hands of every 8th grader as well as every high- school and college student. Its tripple introduction ought to insure it an immense circulation. Of course expression of any suspicion of communistic influence in hurrying Roosevelt out of the picture would be out of question in such a work. But if his ideals as expressed in these letters were known, it is certain that the communists would not hesitate at such a liquidation as many seem to suspect Roosevelt's to have been ..... At all events, I thank you again and may the Lord guide you and all of us.
